caption: Each row is the array after one stage of the 4-wire bitonic network. In stage 1 wires 2 and 3 hold a descending comparator, so 4 stays left of 2; three stages (six comparators in all) turn [3, 1, 4, 2] into [1, 2, 3, 4].

spec.title: 4-input bitonic network, depth 3
spec.aria: Four rows of four numbers, the wires numbered 0 to 3, showing the input 3, 1, 4, 2 and the array after each of the three stages of a 4-input bitonic network, ending with the sorted row 1, 2, 3, 4.
